title: Global CDN Edge Caching & Dynamic Acceleration
learningObjectives: Accelerate dynamic API endpoints using TCP connection reuse and edge TLS termination
Design targeted cache purging via surrogate keys (Cache-Tags)
keyTradeoffs: Aggressive edge caching of semi-dynamic content vs real-time data freshness
Purging cache by exact URL vs wildcard/tag-based invalidation
commonPitfalls: Accidentally caching authenticated responses with `Set-Cookie` headers at the public CDN edge
Missing `Vary: Accept-Encoding` or `Vary: Origin`, causing CORS or compression corruption
transferPrompt: How do CDN edge rules enforce Content Security Policies and WAF security rules?
